description: This Java source file defines the REST API resource for managing clients in the application. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and performing various actions related to clients, such as transfer proposals and account overviews. It also features endpoints for templates and import/export functionalities.

classes.name: ClientsApiResource
classes.description: The main REST resource class exposing various HTTP endpoints for client management and related operations.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template of client details including defaults and allowed values, used for building client UI screens.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of clients with support for pagination, sorting, and filtering.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific client by ID or external ID, with optional fields and templates.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new client from the provided JSON payload.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing client identified by clientId or externalId.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a client if in pending state, identified by clientId or externalId.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Performs various commands such as activate, close, reject, withdraw, transfer, and staff assignment on a client.

methods.name: retrieveAssociatedAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves account overview for a specific client.

methods.name: getClientTemplate
methods.description: Provides an Excel template for client data import.

methods.name: postClientTemplate
methods.description: Uploads an Excel workbook to import client data.

methods.name: retrieveObligeeDetails
methods.description: Fetches obligee (guarantor) details for a client.

methods.name: retrieveTransferTemplate
methods.description: Provides a transfer proposal template for a client.

methods.name: retrieveClient
methods.description: Internal method to fetch client data based on ID or external ID, with optional template augmentation.

methods.name: updateClient
methods.description: Updates client data using a JSON payload.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Deletes client identified by ID or external ID.

methods.name: applyCommand
methods.description: Performs a command operation (activate, close, reject, etc.) on a client identified by externalId.

methods.name: retrieveClientAccounts
methods.description: Fetches account overview for a client.

methods.name: retrieveClientObligeeDetails
methods.description: Fetches obligee details using client ID or external ID.

methods.name: retrieveClientTransferTemplate
methods.description: Provides a transfer proposal template for a client.
